Bijlagen: 2 afbeeldingen

Update on Haiku, webkit-gtk 2.52.2 has been fixes and released by @3dEyes@mastodon.social, with this patch I was able to build it for GTK4 and thus far got Epiphany 50.4 up and running (the latter not released to the public).

Epiphany (Web) 43.1 is fixed also and available for 64bit again.

@3dEyes@mastodon.social also got us a official Firefox port!

https://discuss.haiku-os.org/t/mozilla-officially-gave-us-permission-to-use-the-firefox-name-on-haiku/19582

#HaikuOS #haikuports #epiphany #firefox #opensource #software
